description: Autonomously explore an iOS app (appBundleId), Android app (androidAppId) or web app (url) like a tester — taps, types, navigates — and return findings, coverage and evidence. It OBSERVES: no score, no ship verdict; the deterministic gate (`npx -y @aarwitz/tapp@latest ci`) judges. Runs for minutes; for one screen use tapp_look, for a journey use tapp_session. readOnly:true turns it into the read-only audit (renders and reads, never clicks, crawls `pages` same-origin pages) — the only mode safe against production or a site you do not own. goal:"…" locates a named screen/control from source + the observed UI Map and, inside an active session, takes the shortest observed route there. If the app barely explored (sign-in wall, crash) the result is `inconclusive` — absence of findings is never a pass. When fields were encountered and you have no values, ASK the user.

androidAppId.description: Android: application id on a connected emulator/device

apkPath.description: Android: optional APK to install first

appBundleId.description: iOS: bundle id of the installed app

baselineFindings.description: Findings from a previous run; adds a `regression` comparison (an observation, not a gate)

capture.description: readOnly: write a capture (screenshots, evidence, report.html)

clearData.description: Android: clear app data before launch

device.description: Web: Playwright device profile, e.g. "iPhone 13". iOS: simulator name or UDID — required when more than one simulator is booted (TAPP_UDID is the environment default)

goal.description: A named screen, control or focused task to locate (source-connected) instead of exploring everything

inputOverrides.description: Deterministic field values typed during exploration: {'id:<identifier>'|'label:<label>'|'screen:<title>|id:<identifier>': value}

interactive.description: Host-with-a-human only: pause at input screens and wait for values via interactiveResponsePath

interactiveResponsePath.description: File path the prompting host answers on

linkCheckLimit.description: readOnly: same-origin links to check per page

loginSteps.description: Explicit login replay before exploring: [{action:'type'|'tap'|'wait', target, value?, timeoutMs?}] or 'action:target[:value]' strings; $TEST_EMAIL/$TEST_PASSWORD substituted

mapPath.description: goal: repository-relative UI Map; defaults to .tapp/ui-map.json

pages.description: readOnly: same-origin pages to audit at most

platform.description: goal: optional when no session is active

projectDir.description: goal: repository root; defaults to the MCP workspace

readOnly.description: Read-only audit of `url`: never clicks, types, submits or hovers

url.description: Web: http(s) URL of an app or environment you own

visualReadyPath.description: Local-client temp path written once the iOS target is foregrounded

watch.description: Web: show Tapp's controlled Chromium window and a cursor/HUD

name: tapp_explore
title: Explore the real app (observe — never a verdict)
